mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% triggers a contraction in labor demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such episodes are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or unemployment rate does not exceed 6.5% in the subsequent period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) drives upward pressure on equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to outperform a baseline model that excludes the interaction effect (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals monetary tightening, reducing growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS does not exceed 4.0% in the subsequent period.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor demand (PAYEMS) coupled with low unemployment (UNRATE < 5%) creates a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns fail to outperform a baseline model excluding the labor market interaction (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in economic demand (GDPC1) reflects robust business activity, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising GDPC1 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion with CPIAUCSL below 3.0%, accommodative monetary policy (low FEDFUNDS) sustains growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in such regimes are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or CPIAUCSL does not remain below 3.0% for the full period.

mechanism_narrative: A significant contraction in supply (INDPRO < 95.0) signals economic slowdown, reducing growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in such episodes are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or INDPRO does not fall below 95.0 in the subsequent period.
